_doc: Scenarios for verify.mjs (format in harness/design/VERIFY.md 'Scenario options' and the step list in browser.mjs runStep). Each scenario opens a fresh page (index.html?<pageQuery>) or, with kit.config.json target godot, a fresh Godot run (godotdriver.mjs; `headless: true` runs it headless, no shots or perf), runs its steps in order and fails on the first failed step, any console error, a problem a shot rule reports (debug.shotProblems) or a budget over its fail limit (harness/verify/perf_budgets.json). Keep each scenario small and about one thing. Name it <area>_<what>. Add a `_note` that says what it proves and which task added it. Look rule (P1-002): the game's default look is the signed stylised B (no --style arg). Scenarios that do not judge the look run with `"query": "style=none"` (the flat stand-in look, faster to load): hooks_contract, drive_north, drive_turn_right and coords_north_marker. The others (boot_title, perf_baseline, hooks_no_debug, street_boot, landmarks_boot, areas_boot) run the default look.

scenarios.name: boot_title
scenarios._note: Kit sample. The first screen the player sees, after the game says ready. Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: hooks_contract
scenarios._note: Kit sample. Proves window.__game implements docs/GAME_HOOKS.md: state, clock, frames, input, perf, load, teleport, setCamera, timeScale and the sim hold. The ADOPT phase makes this pass first. Does not judge the look: runs with style=none (P1-002).

scenarios.name: perf_baseline
scenarios._note: Kit sample. One perf window on the first scene, judged against perf_budgets.json. perfQuick keeps it in --quick; heavier perf scenes should leave perfQuick out so they run in --only and --all. Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: hooks_no_debug
scenarios._note: P0-001, ported to Godot in P0-026. Web: opens the game URL without ?debug=1 in an iframe, window.__game.debug is undefined. Godot: the driver launches the game headless without --debug and no port answers (its own and the default), no debug server line, no ERROR lines (GAME_HOOKS.md Rules). The scenario's own debug run is headless (no shot). Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: drive_north
scenarios._note: P0-001. Input only: throttle 3 s of sim from heading 0, z falls by over 10 m and abs x stays under 0.5 m (north is -Z). Does not judge the look: runs with style=none (P1-002).

scenarios.name: tiles_test_block_drive
scenarios._note: P1-018, streamed since P1-019. Boots on the committed test block (game/world/test_tiles, 9 tiles of the ITO flyover and Connaught Place, --tiles=test) with no data/ and no game/world/tiles/: the streamer loads the four ITO tiles round the start, the game says ready only when that ring is attached with its colliders, the car stands on a lane with a collider under it at the drawn height, and a throttle drive moves it along its heading. The load time is judged against the signed 3 s warn line (launch to ready). Does not judge the look: runs with style=none.

scenarios.name: drive_turn_right
scenarios._note: P0-001. Input only: throttle plus steer right, heading grows and x becomes positive (east is +X). Does not judge the look: runs with style=none (P1-002).

scenarios.name: coords_north_marker
scenarios._note: P0-001. Camera at the origin looking north (-Z): the red north post (0,-50) must be in the centre third of the shot. The builder reads the shot. Does not judge the look: runs with style=none (P1-002).

scenarios.name: street_boot
scenarios._note: P0-009. debug.load('street') builds the stand-in Delhi arterial (median, kerbs, service lane, signal junction, flyover ramp stub, shops, traffic, people); the scene reports its id, the sim runs, a shot is taken, no console errors. Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: relight_live_street
scenarios._note: P1-028. The look follows the day clock live: the stand-in street loaded at 17:00 and left running to 20:00 at 0.1 game hours per sim second goes from golden to night without a style rebuild (state().time.live builds unchanged, 20 or more relights), its sodium lamps, shop lights and headlights come on and half its windows light; GPU p95 during the change at most 12 ms by the ballast method (measured inside the script so the window falls in the change); one frame of live relight work at most 4 ms on the main thread. Shots relight_street_golden and relight_street_night. Solo: it measures GPU time.

scenarios.name: relight_live_city
scenarios._note: P1-028. The same live change in the streamed city (full pilot tiles): sky, sun, haze, exposure and grade go from golden to night with no rebuild; the city has no lamps or windows yet (street dressing is P2), so only the light is checked. Shots relight_city_golden and relight_city_night. Solo: it measures GPU time.

scenarios.name: landmarks_boot
scenarios._note: P0-009. debug.load('landmarks') builds one landmark stand-in per tier (hero arch, signature domed tomb, marker block) with surroundings; the scene reports its id, the sim runs, a shot is taken, no console errors. Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: areas_boot
scenarios._note: P0-009. debug.load('areas') builds the two area kit blocks (old city bazaar strip, Lutyens bungalow road) and the third person character stand-in; the scene reports its id, the sim runs, a shot is taken, no console errors. Runs the default look (stylised B since P1-002).

scenarios.name: stream_200
scenarios._note: P1-019. The streaming gate on the full pilot tiles (--tiles=full, needs npm run bake -- pilot): a scripted drive from India Gate to the Red Fort by ITO at 200 km/h for 60 s of sim. No frame over 33 ms after the first 2 s, streaming work at most 1 ms a frame at p99, at most 3 collider chunks a frame and never with a mesh step, tiles held under the cap. The drive goes on into the perf window (scene kind city). Stand-in look (style=none): the look of the streamed city is P2. Not in quick (over a minute, needs the full tiles).

scenarios.name: stream_140
scenarios._note: P1-019. Frame time while the city streams: the stream_200 drive at 140 km/h, measured by the perf window while tiles load and unload (scene kind city: draw calls warn 2,500 fail 3,500). budget: the acceptance is p95 inside the signed warn line of 10 ms, so warn is the fail line here. Stand-in look (style=none); P2 measures again with the city look.

scenarios.name: stream_teleport
scenarios._note: P1-019. Teleport to Connaught Place, the ITO crossing, Chandni Chowk and India Gate on the full pilot tiles: each answers within 2 s of sim with the ring attached, the player on the ground, and a ray down at 5 points hits a collider within 0.05 m of the drawn surface. quickMapped: a change under game/world/ pulls it into quick.

scenarios.name: stream_memory
scenarios._note: P1-019. Five minutes of sim (two laps India Gate, Connaught Place and back at 200 km/h, time scale 4) on the full pilot tiles: tiles held never pass the cap, process memory grows under 50 MB after the first lap, and back at the start the engine object count is within 2 percent of the first time. Not in quick (about 2 minutes).

scenarios.name: car_accel
scenarios._note: P1-020. 0 to 100 km/h with full throttle in 10 to 12 s of sim, input answered in 1 tick. Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_top
scenarios._note: P1-020. Top speed 138 to 143 km/h with full throttle (steady: under 0.1 km/h gained in 3 s). Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_brake
scenarios._note: P1-020. Full brake from 100 km/h stops in 38 to 45 m. Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_lock
scenarios._note: P1-020. Full right lock at a held 38 km/h turns on a radius of 6 to 8 m. Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_kerb
scenarios._note: P1-020. A one-sided 0.15 m kerb at 40 km/h: under 10 degrees of roll, no flip, under 5 percent speed loss. Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_flyover
scenarios._note: P1-020. Over the flyover deck joints at 100 km/h all wheels are in contact for at least 95 percent of the ticks. Runs in the course scene (load('course'): the physics bench course plus a wall), headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: car_cost
scenarios._note: P1-020. Cost per V2 car per tick with 16 more cars driving on the course straight: the median physics iteration (scripts on the tick, the server step, the state sync; the gap between two physics frame starts in one drawn frame, so it runs windowed at time scale 4) with them less without, over 16. Acceptance 0.05 ms or less, printed with the script share. Debug hook vehicle('cost') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd).

scenarios.name: chase_cam_floor
scenarios._note: P1-020. The chase camera over a 20 s drive in the course scene: a reverse into the wall at the south end of the flyover lane, then full throttle up the 6 percent ramp, over its crest (the ramp top) onto the deck. Every drawn frame (debug vehicle('camrec')) the camera is 0.5 m or more above the vehicle, not inside geometry (a 0.1 m sphere) and no wall stands between the vehicle and the camera; six named shots (cam_start, cam_reverse, cam_wall, cam_ramp, cam_crest, cam_deck). Default look. Lockstep: one tick per frame.

scenarios.name: auto_top
scenarios._note: P1-021. The auto (game/data/vehicles/auto.tres): top speed 63 to 67 km/h with full throttle (steady: under 0.1 km/h gained in 3 s). Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: auto_accel
scenarios._note: P1-021. The auto: 0 to 40 km/h with full throttle in 5 to 6 s of sim, input answered in 1 tick. Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: auto_brake
scenarios._note: P1-021. The auto: full brake from 60 km/h stops in 18 to 22 m. Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: auto_lock
scenarios._note: P1-021. The auto: full right lock at a held 15 km/h turns on a radius of 3.5 to 4.5 m. Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: auto_tip
scenarios._note: P1-021. The auto: full right lock at a held 40 km/h, from the moment the lock goes on: under 12 degrees of roll, no tip over, at least 2 wheels down. Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: auto_kerb
scenarios._note: P1-021. The auto: the one-sided 0.15 m kerb at 40 km/h, judged like car_kerb (under 10 degrees of roll, no flip, under 5 percent speed loss). Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: auto_gali_corner
scenarios._note: P1-021. The auto: the course gali (two lanes 3 m wide at a right angle between 2.5 m walls) with scripted inputs (creep at 8 km/h, full right lock at the turn point, out along the east lane): no wall contact of the collision box with a 2 cm skin on any tick. Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: scooter_top
scenarios._note: P1-021. The scooter (game/data/vehicles/scooter.tres): top speed 88 to 92 km/h with full throttle. Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: scooter_accel
scenarios._note: P1-021. The scooter: 0 to 60 km/h with full throttle in 5 to 6 s of sim, input answered in 1 tick. Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: scooter_brake
scenarios._note: P1-021. The scooter: full brake from 80 km/h stops in 25 to 32 m. Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: scooter_stable
scenarios._note: P1-021. The scooter (two wheels with the hidden stabiliser): 30 s full throttle on the straight, then a 12 s slalom at 40 km/h (2 m either side, 24 m wave): no fall, roll of the physics body under 10 degrees on the straight and 15 in the slalom, the drawn body leans into it. Runs in the course scene (load('course')) after vehicle('use') swaps in the tune, headless, at time scale 4; the probe is the debug hook vehicle('run') (game/debug/vehicle_probe.gd), which presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks.

scenarios.name: chase_cam_auto
scenarios._note: P1-021. chase_cam_floor (P1-020) with the auto (vehicle('use')): the reverse into the wall, the 6 percent ramp, the crest and the deck; every drawn frame the camera is 0.5 m or more above the vehicle, not inside geometry and not behind a wall; six named shots auto_cam_start, _reverse, _wall, _ramp, _crest, _deck. Default look. Lockstep.

scenarios.name: chase_cam_scooter
scenarios._note: P1-021. chase_cam_floor (P1-020) with the scooter (vehicle('use')): the reverse into the wall, the 6 percent ramp, the crest and the deck; every drawn frame the camera is 0.5 m or more above the vehicle, not inside geometry and not behind a wall; six named shots scooter_cam_start, _reverse, _wall, _ramp, _crest, _deck. Default look. Lockstep.

scenarios.name: foot_speeds
scenarios._note: P1-022. On foot in the course scene: walk, jog, sprint and crouch from rest on the open pad; the ground speed over 2 s after 1 s to get going is within 3 percent of GAME.md (1.6, 3.8, 6.5, 1.2 m/s). Debug hook foot('run', {test: 'speeds'}) (game/debug/foot_routes.gd) presses the InputMap actions and measures in sim ticks; headless at time scale 4.

scenarios.name: foot_stamina
scenarios._note: P1-022. Sprint from a full stamina bar until it runs out: 8 s within 0.3 s; standing, the bar refills in 5 s within 0.3 s. foot('run', {test: 'stamina'}), sim ticks, headless at time scale 4.

scenarios.name: foot_jump
scenarios._note: P1-022. A jump from standing and one while jogging: apex 0.42 to 0.48 m reached in 0.27 to 0.33 s (GAME.md 0.45 m in 0.30 s). foot('run', {test: 'jump'}), headless.

scenarios.name: foot_vault
scenarios._note: P1-022. The course vault lane: a 1.2 m wall and a 1.0 m railing are vaulted in 0.5 to 0.7 s (jump pressed 0.75 m before the face while jogging) and the body ends past the far face with no overlap; a 1.3 m wall is not vaulted. foot('run', {test: 'vault'}), headless.

scenarios.name: foot_turn
scenarios._note: P1-022. Jogging north, let go of W and hold S: the body faces south within 1 degree after 0.20 to 0.30 s (GAME.md 180 degrees in 0.25 s). foot('run', {test: 'turn'}), headless.

scenarios.name: foot_kerb_stairs
scenarios._note: P1-022. The course kerb and stair lane (10 kerb slabs of 0.15 m, a 12 step stair of 0.18 m risers, a landing, a 1 in 8 ramp) at walk, jog and sprint, north and south, from three start offsets each: under 5 percent speed loss, no snag (no 0.2 s under 80 percent of the gait), every run comes through. foot('run', {test: 'kerbs', gait, run}), headless at time scale 8.

scenarios.name: foot_cost
scenarios._note: P1-022. Cost per on-foot character per tick with 16 more characters walking on the course pad: the median physics iteration with them less without, over 16 (windowed at time scale 4 so a drawn frame holds two or more ticks). Acceptance 0.05 ms or less. foot('cost').

scenarios.name: foot_cam_walls
scenarios._note: P1-022. The on-foot camera over a 20 s route in the course camera yard, input only: into a lane 2 m wide between 3 m walls, a hard camera turn while running in it, along the court wall on the shoulder side, backing into the north west corner (S runs toward the camera), a full camera circle there, then crouched behind a 1.0 m wall with the camera looking over it (about 24 s in all). Every drawn frame (foot('camrec')) the camera is 0.6 m or more from the head, a 0.1 m sphere at it touches no geometry, the head is in the frame and some ray to the head, chest or hips is clear or passes only faded walls; the low wall fades. Seven named shots foot_cam_open, _lane_in, _lane_turn, _wall_side, _corner_back, _corner_turn, _low_wall. Default look. Lockstep.

scenarios.name: enter_exit_vehicle
scenarios._note: P1-022. In the course scene the player starts in the car: F gets out (under 2 s, the on-foot camera, no overlap, beside the door), F gets back in (under 2 s, the chase camera, the car drives), and from 2 m away F walks to the door and gets in under 2 s. state().player.mode reports foot or vehicle. Shots exit_on_foot, enter_driving, walk_to_door, walk_enter_driving. Default look. Lockstep.

scenarios.name: foot_anim
scenarios._note: P1-023, P2-041. The humanoid on the course pad at walk, jog and sprint (foot('anim', {gait}), input only): over three gait cycles the play rate of each gait's clip is between 0.9 and 1.15 (1 is the built clip's own pace; printed with the cadence and how much faster the built cycle is than the library clip), the planted foot's mean backward speed in the body frame is within 5 percent of the ground speed and the planted ball moves under 5 percent of the ground covered (foot_contact.gd: a foot is planted while its ball is on the ground, so the flight of a run is not counted), at all three gaits; the body plays the walk, jog and sprint states; the animation with the body feel costs under 0.05 ms per character a tick among 16. Headless.

scenarios.name: foot_anim_shots
scenarios._note: P1-023. Shots of the humanoid from the on-foot play camera in the course scene, input only: foot_anim_walk (walking on the pad), foot_anim_sprint (sprinting), foot_anim_vault (in the middle of the vault over the 1.2 m wall) and lead_lineup (Bittu, SI Meera Rana and Danny side by side, the camera turned to face them, foot('lineup')). Checks the body states (walk, sprint, vault) when each shot is taken. Read by the verifier against VERIFY.md rubric lines 11 and 22. Default look. Lockstep.

scenarios.name: foot_feel
scenarios._note: P2-041. How the on-foot body moves, in numbers, input only, course scene (foot('feel', {test})). pops: a start from standing, a stop from a jog and a plant-and-turn back (stop and turn at three points of the gait cycle) read every tick in skeleton space: trunk bones turn at most 12 degrees a tick, limb bones 42, the hips' step changes by at most 0.045 m and an ankle's by 0.17 m from one tick to the next; the steady walk, jog and sprint are the base line under the same limits (a jog: 4.9 degrees, 0.108 m). ik: at a walk and a jog over the kerb lane and the stairs, of the planted feet (the animation has the foot down, the capsule on the ground) the 95th percentile is within 0.02 m of the surface, 97 percent or more within 0.03 m, the worst under 0.12 m, and the hips never step more than 0.065 m in a tick beyond the body's own climb (the capsule hops 0.15 to 0.18 m); the jog down the stairs is reported only (a string of falls). Known gap: single walking steps off a kerb or over a stair edge are 0.05 to 0.09 m off for a few ticks. camera: over a start, a sprint, a stop and a turn back the follow lag stays between 0.03 and 0.15 m, no position is more than 6 mm off the middle of its neighbours and that offset never reverses from one tick to the next (no jitter). Headless.

scenarios.name: foot_feel_strip
scenarios._note: P2-041. Frame strips of the on-foot body, input only, in the course scene: a walk, a jog, a sprint, a start from standing, a stop from a jog and a plant-and-turn back, 12 frames each a few ticks apart, every frame taken from the play camera and from a side camera level with the hips while the sim is held. Checks that the start, stop and turn clips play. `node harness/bin/footstrip.mjs` runs it and lays the shots out under harness/reports/foot/ (strip_<move>.png and strips.png), which the verifier reads against VERIFY.md and the task's 'grounded, not bouncy' bar. Default look. Lockstep.

scenarios.name: lead_sheet
scenarios._note: P2-063. Shot sheets of the three lead models (rig/lead_<id>.scn), input only, course scene, default look: per lead (the player dressed as that lead, foot('dress')) standing front, side, back and three quarter from 3 m (the play level of the mesh), a close-up of the head and chest from 0.95 m (the full mesh), the hands from 1.1 m, a walk and a jog from the play camera and from a side camera level with the hips, and for Bittu and Danny the seated Driving pose (stand-in for the auto seat and the scooter ride). Checks each body is drawn on its own model and plays the asked state. `node harness/bin/leadsheet.mjs` runs it and lays the shots out under harness/reports/leads/ (<id>.png), which the verifier reads against VERIFY.md and the model cards. Lockstep.

scenarios.name: lead_anim
scenarios._note: P2-063. Each lead on its own model and its own locomotion clips (rig/loco_<id>.res, built on its skeleton), input only, course scene: per lead (foot('dress')) foot('anim') at walk, jog and sprint (play rate 0.9 to 1.15, planted foot slide and wander under 5 percent) and foot('feel', {test: 'pops'}) at a steady walk, jog and sprint (trunk bones at most 12 degrees a tick, limbs 42, the hips' step changes by at most 0.045 m and an ankle's by 0.17 m). Headless.

scenarios.name: lead_compare
scenarios._note: P2-063. Side by sides of the painted stand-in mannequin and each lead's own model in the same frame of idle, walk and jog (same staging and timing), from behind and from the side, input only, course scene, sim held. Shots cmp_<id>_<standin|model>_<move>_<back|side>, laid out by `node harness/bin/leadsheet.mjs --compare` as harness/reports/leads/compare_<id>.png. Lockstep.

scenarios.name: lead_street
scenarios._note: P2-063. The three lead models in a real street at player height (full pilot tiles, spawn pin chandni_chowk_east, default look): out of the auto with F, a few steps along Chandni Chowk, then each lead in turn (foot('dress')) from the on-foot play camera and from 2.2 m in front at eye height, sim held. Checks each is drawn on its own model. Shots lead_<id>_street_play and lead_<id>_street_close, laid out by harness/bin/leadsheet.mjs. Lockstep.

scenarios.name: city_landmark_pins
scenarios._note: P1-024 base test 1, in the streamed city (the main scene). India Gate, the Connaught Place central park, the Red Fort, Jama Masjid, the ITO crossing and the New Delhi station forecourt: each landmark pin of the live tiles lies within 5 m of the point the game projects from its latitude and longitude (city geo, pins; staged by teleport), the Red Fort is north-east of India Gate and Connaught Place north-west. Does not judge the look: style=none.

scenarios.name: city_collide_probe
scenarios._note: P1-024 base test 2a: 200 seeded ray probes over 10 pilot tiles (city_routes.json probeTiles): every collider hit lies within 0.05 m of the highest drawn surface of the tile files at that point (city surface). Does not judge the look: style=none.

scenarios.name: city_ito_flyover_drive
scenarios._note: P1-024 base test 2b: the auto drives over the Ring Road flyover near ITO (route ito_flyover, real inputs): every wheel contact within 0.05 m of the drawn surface (city watch), never under it, never stuck. Shot city_ito_flyover_eye on the deck at the play camera (default look).

scenarios.name: city_cp_circle_lap
scenarios._note: P1-024 base test 2c: one clockwise lap of the Connaught Place inner circle in the auto (route cp_lap, real inputs): the lap closes, every wheel contact within 0.05 m of the drawn surface, never under it, never stuck. Does not judge the look: style=none.

scenarios.name: city_chandni_walk
scenarios._note: P1-024 base test 2d: the auto drives Netaji Subhash Marg and the lane south of Chandni Chowk (route chandni_main; P2-045: the main road is car-free, the auto keeps off it), F gets the player out and the player walks up a two-wheeler gali onto Chandni Chowk main road (walk chandni_gali), real inputs: wheels and feet within 0.05 m of the drawn surface, never under it, never stuck; the streaming focus follows the walker. Shot city_chandni_gali_foot at the on-foot camera (default look).

scenarios.name: city_access_bollards
scenarios._note: P2-042: a car turns from Netaji Subhash Marg into the Red Fort end of Chandni Chowk (a non-motorised zone in the day) and the bollard line (colliders, gaps under 1.3 m) stops it 1 to 5 m short, at rest; real inputs (route chandni_bollards of city_routes.json). scenarios.name: landmark_heroes
scenarios._note: P2-007. The parts kit heroes at player height from their named poses (game/data/landmark_poses.json): India Gate first sight on Kartavya Path, near and from 1.5 and 2.5 km; the Red Fort's Lahori Gate from Netaji Subhash Marg and from Chandni Chowk; the Connaught Place colonnade from the inner circle; Jama Masjid from the road at its grounds. Every kit landmark is built, its built height is within 5 percent of the registry height (city('kit')), the landmark looked at is in the middle half of the frame, Jama Masjid is flagged worship and never a combat arena. Shots hero_* and sig_jama_masjid (default look).

scenarios.name: landmarks_two_heroes
scenarios._note: P2-007 perf. The landmark GPU cost with two heroes in view (India Gate at full detail with the Connaught Place circle on the same line of sight; the Red Fort's Lahori Gate with Jama Masjid): the frame with every landmark shown minus the frame with them hidden (city('kit', {visible})), with the GPU ballast on (harness/bin/ballast.mjs method), median of 4 alternating pairs. Budget perf_budgets.json world.gpuMs.landmarks, 0.5 ms. Not in quick.

scenarios.name: landmark_pop_seq
scenarios._note: P2-007. A 140 km/h approach to India Gate along Kartavya Path as a frame sequence (one frame every 150 ms, 5.83 m apart) through each level change (1,800, 900 and 350 m): shots pop_ig_<boundary>_<k>. Then node harness/bin/popcheck.mjs crops the arch from each frame, writes the sheets pop_ig_<boundary>_sheet.png and fails on a frame to frame change well over its neighbours (a pop). Not in quick.
